title: 3193. Count the Number of Inversions

examples.explanation: The two permutations are: [2, 0, 1] Prefix [2, 0, 1] has inversions (0, 1) and (0, 2). Prefix [2] has 0 inversions. [1, 2, 0] Prefix [1, 2, 0] has inversions (0, 2) and (1, 2). Prefix [1] has 0 inversions.
The only satisfying permutation is [2, 0, 1]: Prefix [2, 0, 1] has inversions (0, 1) and (0, 2). Prefix [2, 0] has an inversion (0, 1). Prefix [2] has 0 inversions.
The only satisfying permutation is [0, 1]: Prefix [0] has 0 inversions. Prefix [0, 1] has no inversions.
